description: This file defines the EmployeeEmergencyContactsController class, a PHP controller class for managing employee emergency contact views within the OrangeHRM system. It handles pre-render logic such as setting up Vue components and permissions based on the employee number received from HTTP requests.

classes.name: EmployeeEmergencyContactsController
classes.description: A controller class extending BaseViewEmployeeController, responsible for preparing the employee emergency contacts view, including setting Vue components and permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating a Vue component for employee emergency contacts and setting permissions based on the employee number in the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups for capability permission checks, specifically related to emergency contacts.
